Subject: Coordinating next-week demo for StackBridge / Redwood (APAC + US attendees)

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks again for the intro at the summit. StackBridge would like to run a 45–60 minute co-sell demo next week that includes our SI lead (APAC), Redwood product, and a short ops runbook walkthrough for marketplace listing. Goal: show the joint deployment flow on AWS and confirm marketplace listing steps.

Constraints:
- Our SI lead (Liam) is in APAC (UTC+8) and available mornings his time.
- Two of our devs are strictly East Coast (US) and prefer afternoons EST.

Can you share a couple of candidate windows that will work for Redwood + SI? Also, would appreciate an ops contact to build a short runbook so we can avoid late-stage redlines.

Thanks —
Samantha Ortiz
Partnerships, StackBridge

Hi Samantha —

Great to hear — excited to run this. Quick thoughts and asks:

1) Candidate windows (we'll hold each for 90 minutes to allow buffer/fallback):
   - Tue Nov 24 14:30–16:00 EST (Wed 03:30–05:00 SGT) — early but doable for brief APAC participation if Liam is open to early morning.
   - Wed Nov 25 11:00–12:30 EST (Wed 00:00–01:30 SGT) — slightly better for US-dominant audience.
   - Thu Nov 26 16:00–17:30 EST (Fri 05:00–06:30 SGT) — later in US, late for APAC.

2) Ops/runbook owners: looping in Karthik (product integrations) and Vanessa (marketplace ops) to coordinate a short runbook draft and a 10-minute prelube with the SI. Karthik/Vanessa — can you take point on the runbook and share a 1–page draft by EOD Wednesday?

3) Recording & fallback plan: we suggest a short recorded walkthrough and an automatic fallback to a pre-recorded demo if connectivity issues arise. We'll include that language in the runbook.

I'll create calendar holds and a shared folder for artifacts. Attaching a tentative calendar invite (holding one of the slots) and a skeleton runbook template.

Best,
Jasmine Liu

Thanks — quick ops note.

We should avoid single-slot assumptions given the timezone split. Proposal: a slot rotation + failover plan so the SI can demo the APAC-specific steps in the first 20 minutes and then hand off to the US-focused use cases. Concrete suggestion:

- 15-minute pre-call with SI and Redwood ops to validate the runbook (recorded).
- Main session 60 minutes: 20 min APAC SI demo, 30 min Redwood demo (cloud deploy + marketplace listing), 10 min Q&A.
- 30-minute post-call triage for technical follow-ups (separate opt-in calendar).

I uploaded a short draft runbook to the Drive link Jasmine shared and added a checklist: preflight checklist, recording fallback, and user permissions required for marketplace listing. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRunbook

Vanessa — can you add the marketplace checklist items (owner, listing name, billing contact)?
